regions.full_page: Mrs. F. Marentette, enrolled four years ago To-day - then thought to be dying of tuberculosis - comes asking for help to start a poor neighbors' children to school. Fr. S. sent her to J. Caneff who gave her a check for $50.00 ... Same J. C. had not 50c a year ago to pay for his enrollment. Shortly afterwards he got employ- ment, where he works since. Recently his salary was raised to $ 100.00 per week.
